meta.name: planning-with-files-zht
meta.description: 用於多步驟 AI 代理工作的持久化檔案規劃。將 task_plan.md、findings.md 與 progress.md 保存在磁碟上，生命週期鉤子會注入選定的專案規劃內容。自動恢復只讀取專案規劃檔案；只有明確執行 session-catchup.py --metadata 才會檢查本機同一專案的代理工作階段中繼資料，--replay 則會輸出有界且以 nonce 框定的摘錄。選用的閘門模式只會在主機支援時要求繼續，而且絕不執行 Markdown 中宣告的命令。此技能沒有網路上傳路徑。適用於研究或需要超過 5 次工具呼叫的工作。觸發詞：任務規劃、專案計畫、制定計畫、分解任務、多步驟規劃、進度追蹤、檔案規劃、幫我規劃、拆解專案

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 拆解多步任务并持久保存计划与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常让 AI 处理需要多步完成且容易中断的复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Split complex work into trackable steps and save progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often ask AI to handle complex multi-step tasks that can be interrupted

howto.what: Claude 会改用本地三个 Markdown 文件(task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md)存放计划、发现与进度,每次对话开始时自动读取并注入当前计划与最近进度;这些内容只当数据处理,不执行其中的命令,也不会上传。
howto.when: 当你提到“任务规划”“拆解项目”等,或任务属研究/需超过5次工具调用时,Claude 会进入文件规划模式;已有 task_plan.md 时对话开始会自动恢复计划上下文。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目拆成阶段计划,存成 task_plan.md 再开工。
say.note: 会生成计划文件并按阶段推进。

say.text: 我要做多步骤研究,请用 findings.md 持续记录关键发现。
say.note: 研究成果落盘,减少上下文丢失。

howto.what_en: Claude writes plans, findings, and progress into three local Markdown files (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md), then injects the current plan and recent progress at the start of each conversation. The content is only treated as data: no commands inside it are executed and nothing is uploaded.
howto.when_en: Activated when you mention planning keywords such as “任务规划” or “拆解项目”, or when the job involves research or is expected to need more than 5 tool calls. If a task_plan.md already exists, conversation start also resumes that plan's context.

say_en.text: Break this project into phases and save them in task_plan.md before starting.
say_en.note: Creates a plan file and proceeds phase by phase.

say_en.text: I'm doing multi-step research; keep logging key findings in findings.md.
say_en.note: Persists findings to disk and reduces context loss.

say_en.text: Continue from task_plan.md and record recent actions in progress.md.
